name: Certificate Lifecycle
description: Compute a certificate's validity window, expiry countdown and renewal advice.

hints.certificate: Paste the PEM text; parsing goes through pkisvc for consistency with the other certificate tools.
hints.output: The status is one of valid, expiring, expired or not yet valid.

faq.q: Does it check the certificate chain?
faq.a: No, it looks at a single certificate. Use the chain verifier for chains.
Clients must trust that CA explicitly, so they are unsuitable for public environments.
